## Work still required under merged B-562

Use the [servers plan T19a](../../../../packages/eng-harness/docs/plans/0002-servers-and-adapters.md), [engine spec](../../../../packages/eng-harness/docs/specs/0001-engine.md) and [servers spec AC36 and AC52](../../../../packages/eng-harness/docs/specs/0002-servers-and-adapters.md). B-562 added twelve authorized source and test paths. The port capability, strict optional journal field and engine changes there remain to be implemented. Key acceptance cases follow.

- The capability defaults to false. CSI opts in only for a pathless `csi_open_model` of the configured original. Persist explicit true on the individual write-open attempt. Missing, null, false and legacy journal data use conservative behavior. Preserve the canonical old payload form and the raw write effect for permissions, leases, units, sibling exclusion, unknown-outcome reconciliation, retries and restore restrictions.
- Preserve prior dirty state and compare actual content writes. Skip the expected original absence only on the specific completed or reconciled-applied open with its exact applicable completed EC1 copy, distinct source and copy keys, and the matching historical working-copy save at that path within the copy attempt. Later invalidating state, actual original or copy writes, pending operations, loss, reopened hosts and restore cuts retain the applicable recovery and content checks. A later content-free open must leave earlier write and save provenance available.
- Complete binding and units before a still-live EC1 copy for immediate applied and replay cases. Replay the recorded copy without rebinding the original. Keep explicit engineer choices for unreconciled or unknown outcomes, and use the existing AC34 choice when an applied save requires a new baseline. Preserve one logical write per cut and current proof requirements.

A clean committed six-write matrix, the added B-562 regressions, formal test-first, full package gate, required mutation evidence, final independent implementation and sources reviews, and local CI on the exact PR head still remain. The fake-host suite and owner-side Windows/real ETABS checks cover separate acceptance steps.
